domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record retrieved. DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection errors on all three attempts ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>"), so domestic-side verification could not be performed. ImportKey buyer list shows Indian counterparties (e.g. "ATAL ENGINEERING LIMITED", "ANALOGUE TECHNICAL AGENCIES LIMITED") but these are aggregated counterparty counts, not dated domestic supply records, so they are not treated as evidence.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated outbound customs bills of lading from Ahmedabad ICD/air ACC to UAE (Jebel Ali, 2026-02-28), Saudi Arabia (Dammam, 2026-02-19 and 2026-02-13) and Kenya (Mombasa, 2026-02-17), all under HS 84314920 — which matches the declared 843149 (crane/earthmoving parts). Declared HS 441293 is not corroborated by any observed row; actual observed code is 84314920, so per project rule 3 the code should be corrected to 84314920 rather than the company rejected. The company also imports (crane anti-collision devices, HS 85318000, from Henan Safersync, 2026-02-25), i.e. it is a manufacturer_trader profile: buys Chinese components and re-exports crane parts/radio remotes. Domestic supply evidence is null/unknown — not because it is absent, but because the search tool was unavailable; no GST turnover figure or tender record is public in what was retrieved, so no number is invented. Second slug variant 'cmk-electro-power-pvt-ltd' returned an empty page (no records), so the first slug is the authoritative one.
